contract.reason: The Heimgeist repository is being decommissioned as an active meta-agent. The schema remains only to interpret historical events and repository fixtures.

evidence: The repository exposes no repository_dispatch receiver for the Heimgewebe command event at the observed head.
Its former Plexer consumer path was hard-disabled and merged in heimgewebe/plexer#104.

runtimeCutover.effect: HEIMGEIST_URL and HEIMGEIST_TOKEN remain parse-compatible but no longer activate a live Plexer consumer or create new Heimgeist delivery attempts.

historicalReaders.reason: Validation and documentation may retain the event family so historical ledger entries remain interpretable.
No active producer dependency is established; retained references are historical only.
Existing Heimgeist fixtures/rendering references are archival visualization data, not runtime authority.
